findings.summary: Abshir Omar served as Registered Agent for AFLAX PCA Services LLC (Medicaid PCA provider), managed by Liban Isse; inactive since 2019
findings.detail: MN SOS filing for AFLAX PCA Services, LLC (file no. 863441100029) lists Abshir Omar as Registered Agent and Liban Isse as Manager. Address: 2180 Londin Lane Apt 305, Saint Paul, MN 55119. Medicaid Personal Care Assistance (PCA) provider. Administratively terminated 2019-03-19 for failure to renew.

findings.summary: Abshir Omar was a paid FOF consultant and Tasho deputy director (6 sites, $2.7M reimbursed); not charged or named in FBI warrants as of March 2026
findings.detail: Minnesota Reformer (Oct 2022), Star Tribune, and other outlets report Abshir Omar served as a paid consultant for Feeding Our Future and was deputy director of Tasho nonprofit, which ran 6 food distribution sites claiming 4,000 meals/day under FOF sponsorship and received approximately $2.7M in state reimbursements. Omar was not charged or named in any FBI search warrants through 2025.

findings.summary: Abshir Omar is Manager of Parklawn Logistics LLC (trucking, Edina MN); Liban Omar is Registered Agent; email abshiromar@live.com confirmed
findings.detail: MN SOS filing for Parklawn Logistics LLC (file no. 1216431300024) lists Abshir Omar as Manager and Liban Omar as Registered Agent. Principal executive office at 4280 Parklawn Ave S, Apt 202, Edina, MN 55435. FMCSA: USDOT 3557291, MC-1193493. Contact: abshiromar@live.com, 612-532-2379. Active carrier authorized for interstate property transport. 2 trucks, 2 drivers.

findings.summary: Abshir Omar formally registered as Manager of Cosmopolitan Business Properties LLC (MN) with personal address matching the property purchased through that LLC with FOF fraud funds
findings.detail: MN SOS filing for Cosmopolitan Business Properties LLC (file no. 1240280700025) lists Abshir Omar as Manager with address 2722 Park Ave S, Minneapolis, MN 55407 — the same address as the principal executive office of the LLC. The LLC was incorporated six weeks before the property was purchased (July 26, 2021) for $2,780,000 using proceeds that included at least $560,000 in fraudulent Federal Child Nutrition Program funds.

findings.summary: Cosmopolitan Business Properties LLC used to purchase 2722/2742 Park Ave S, Minneapolis for $2.78M including $560K in FOF fraud funds; Abshir Omar is registered Manager of this entity
findings.detail: DOJ press release for the 47th FOF conviction states Ghedi 'transferred approximately $560,000 in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds to Cosmopolitan Business Properties LLC—a shell company he co-owned with other co-conspirators—toward the purchase of a mansion and adjoining property located at 2722 and 2742 Park Avenue South in Minneapolis.' The property was purchased July 26, 2021 for $2,780,000 and is subject to federal forfeiture. Hennepin County records show CBP LLC as owner since July 2021.

findings.summary: Abshir Omar facilitated December 2021 meeting between AG Keith Ellison and FOF figures, offering political support; occurred ~1 month before FBI raids
findings.detail: Star Tribune reporting identifies Abshir Omar as the facilitator of a meeting in December 2021 between Keith Ellison and Feeding Our Future-connected figures. Omar offered political support to Ellison contingent on Ellison's cooperation. This occurred approximately one month before the FBI raids on FOF in January 2022.

findings.summary: Abshir Omar served as Registered Agent for Faith Logistics LLC (Saint Paul, MN); entity lasted only 13 months before termination; manager identity unknown
findings.detail: MN SOS filing for Faith Logistics LLC (file no. 1439069500020) lists Abshir Omar as Registered Agent. Address: 371 Winthrop St S Apt 190, Saint Paul, MN 55119. Administratively terminated 2025-01-21 after only 13 months. Manager not identified in public filing.

findings.summary: CBP LLC was reactivated Sept-Oct 2024 (coinciding with Ghedi plea proceedings) then re-terminated Jan 2026; purpose of reactivation unknown — possible forfeiture cooperation
findings.detail: Cosmopolitan Business Properties LLC was administratively terminated in February 2023 (failure to renew), then reinstated September 26, 2024 and amended October 10, 2024, then terminated again January 21, 2026. This period of reactivation coincides with Ghedi's plea proceedings (47th conviction). The reinstatement and amendment may reflect forfeiture-related legal activity, cooperation with prosecutors, or regulatory compliance for asset disposition. Causal mechanism not confirmed.

connections.description: Abshir Omar is the registered Manager of Cosmopolitan Business Properties LLC (MN SOS). Ahmed Abdullahi Ghedi is the convicted co-owner of the same entity per DOJ (47th FOF conviction). CBP LLC received $560K in FOF fraud funds and purchased 2722/2742 Park Ave S, Minneapolis for $2.78M. The co-ownership relationship is structural and documented.

Abshir Omar is listed as Manager of Parklawn Logistics LLC. Liban Omar is the Registered Agent for the same entity. Shared surname and address suggest a family/personal relationship. No separate investigative file on Liban Omar found.

Abshir Omar is the registered MN SOS manager of Cosmopolitan Business Properties LLC and listed the 2722 Park Ave property as his personal address. His connection to the CBS/Safari principals is not established through public registry records; he may be a nominee manager.

Abshir Omar served as Registered Agent for AFLAX PCA Services LLC. Liban Isse served as Manager of the same entity. Shared entity registration connects them; nature of personal relationship is unknown.

Abshir Omar was a paid consultant for Feeding Our Future and facilitated the December 2021 meeting between AG Ellison and FOF figures. Aimee Bock was the FOF founder/executive director convicted at trial. Their relationship is operational — they shared the FOF organizational context during the fraud period.

Both Abshir Omar (via CBP LLC) and Abdulkadir Nur Salah (via Cosmopolitan Business Solutions d/b/a Safari Restaurant) are linked to the 2722 Park Ave S property in Minneapolis. Salah's network (Safari Restaurant) occupied the property as FOF HQ; CBP LLC holds title. Relationship is address-based overlap rather than a documented direct personal tie.

Abshir Omar served as campaign manager for Nasri Warsame (Minneapolis City Council candidate). Warsame is connected to the broader Minneapolis Somali political network that intersects with multiple FOF-connected individuals.
